description: Update the campaign wizard UI (+page.svelte) to implement Mode A: file upload dropzone on step 4, match column picker with preview table on step 5, canNext() fixes, extended DraftState, and a multi-step launch flow with unmatched-file warning. Depends on FEAT-002 (the API endpoints this UI calls must exist). Must not break Mode B or Mode C flows.
steps: 1. Open src/routes/(app)/dashboard/campaigns/new/+page.svelte. Read the full file first (it is long — use offset to read in chunks if needed). Add two new $state variables after the existing state block: `let selectedFiles = $state<File[]>([]);` and `let matchColumn = $state('');`.

2. Fix canNext() in the $derived block. Change `case 4: return mode === 'C' || templateId !== '';` to `case 4: return mode === 'A' ? selectedFiles.length > 0 : (mode === 'C' || templateId !== '');`. Change `case 5: return true;` to `case 5: return mode !== 'A' || matchColumn !== '';`.

3. Replace the Mode A block inside Step 4 ({#if mode === 'A'}). Remove the existing static

and

. Add: (a) a hidden with tabindex=0, role=button, aria-label='Upload files', onclick triggering fileInput.click(), ondragover=(e)=>{e.preventDefault(); dragging=true;}, ondragleave=()=>{dragging=false;}, ondrop handler that merges e.dataTransfer.files into selectedFiles. Add `let dragging = $state(false)` and a `let fileInputEl: HTMLInputElement` bound via bind:this. (c) Inside the dropzone: a material-symbols-outlined upload icon, the prompt text, and a count badge showing selectedFiles.length when > 0. (d) Below the dropzone: a
    listing each file in selectedFiles with filename, formatted size (use a local formatSize helper: bytes < 1024 → Xb, < 1048576 → X KB, else X MB), and a remove button (×) that filters the file out of selectedFiles by index.

4. Replace the Mode A block inside Step 5 ({#if mode === 'A'}). Remove the existing <div class='matching-note'>. Add: (a) A <div class='field-group'> with <label for='match-col'>Match filenames against column</label> and a <select id='match-col' bind:value={matchColumn}> listing datasetColumns with a blank default option 'Select column…'. (b) A $derived previewMatches computed from selectedFiles and previewRecipients: const previewMatches = $derived(() => { if (!matchColumn || selectedFiles.length === 0) return []; return selectedFiles.map(f => { const fileKey = f.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '').trim().toLowerCase(); const match = previewRecipients.find(r => String((r as Record<string,string>)[matchColumn] ?? '').trim().toLowerCase() === fileKey); return { filename: f.name, matchValue: match ? (match as Record<string,string>)[matchColumn] : null, matched: !!match }; }); }). (c) If previewMatches().length > 0, render a <table class='match-preview-table'> with thead (Filename / Match value / Status) and tbody rows. Unmatched rows get class 'unmatched' with red text ✗. Matched rows show ✓. (d) Summary line below table: '{matched} of {total} files matched in preview'.

5. Update DraftState interface: add `matchColumn: string` and `selectedFileNames: string[]`. Update saveDraft() to include `matchColumn, selectedFileNames: selectedFiles.map(f => f.name)`. Update loadDraft() to restore `matchColumn = d.matchColumn ?? ''`. Add a reactive note in the Step 4 UI: if showDraftBanner and selectedFiles.length === 0 and loadedDraft had selectedFileNames.length > 0, show a small info message 'Previously selected files: {names}. Please re-select your files.' (File objects cannot be persisted in localStorage).

6. Update the launch() function. Add state variables: `let launchProgress = $state<{label: string; status: 'pending'|'running'|'done'|'error'}[]>([]);`, `let unmatchedWarning = $state<{count:number; files:string[]}|null>(null);`, `let launchCampaignId = $state<string|null>(null);`. Rewrite launch() as an async function. For mode !== 'A': keep the exact existing logic (single POST to /api/campaigns, goto on success). For mode === 'A': (a) Init launchProgress = [{ label: 'Creating campaign', status: 'pending' }, { label: 'Uploading files', status: 'pending' }, { label: 'Matching files', status: 'pending' }, { label: 'Activating campaign', status: 'pending' }]. (b) Step 1: set progress[0].status='running', POST /api/campaigns with file_match_config: { match_column: matchColumn }, on success store campaign_id in launchCampaignId, set progress[0].status='done'; on error set progress[0].status='error', set launchError, set launching=false, return. (c) Step 2: set progress[1].status='running', build FormData appending each file in selectedFiles, POST /api/campaigns/{launchCampaignId}/files, on error set progress[1].status='error', set launchError, set launching=false, return; on success set progress[1].status='done'. (d) Step 3: set progress[2].status='running', POST /api/campaigns/{launchCampaignId}/match with { match_column: matchColumn }, on success collect unmatched count/files, set progress[2].status='done'. If unmatched > 0: set unmatchedWarning={count, files}, set launching=false, return (user will confirm or go back via UI buttons). (e) Step 4 (also callable from 'Continue anyway' button): set progress[3].status='running', POST /api/campaigns/{launchCampaignId}/activate, on success set progress[3].status='done', clearDraft(), goto(`/dashboard/campaigns/${launchCampaignId}`); on error set progress[3].status='error', set launchError. Add helper function `async function continueAfterUnmatchedWarning()` that clears unmatchedWarning, sets launching=true, and calls the activate step directly.

7. Update Step 10 UI template to show Mode A launch progress. When mode === 'A' and launchProgress.length > 0, replace the single spinner with a vertical step list rendering each launchProgress entry with an appropriate icon (pending: circle, running: spinning sync icon, done: check_circle in green, error: error in red). When unmatchedWarning is not null, show a warning card: 'Warning: {count} file(s) have no matching recipient: {files.join(', ')}. These recipients will receive the email without an attachment.' with two buttons: 'Go Back' (resets unmatchedWarning, step=4, launching=false) and 'Continue Anyway' (calls continueAfterUnmatchedWarning()). Keep existing Mode B/C spinner/error/ready UI in an {:else} branch.
acceptance_criteria: npm run check passes with zero errors
Mode A wizard step 4 shows a functional file dropzone; Next button is disabled until at least one file is selected
Mode A wizard step 5 shows a column picker dropdown and a preview match table; Next button is disabled until a column is selected
Mode B and Mode C wizard flows are completely unchanged
The launch flow for Mode A shows 4 progress steps and correctly calls /api/campaigns, /files, /match, /activate in sequence
Unmatched file warning is shown and user can choose to continue or go back
ZIP files can be selected in the file input (UI level — actual extraction happens server-side)
verification: npm run check — must report 0 errors
findings: Implemented all 7 steps. Added selectedFiles/$state, matchColumn, dragging, fileInputEl, launchProgress, unmatchedWarning, launchCampaignId state variables. Fixed canNext() for step 4 (Mode A requires files) and step 5 (Mode A requires matchColumn). Replaced Mode A step 4 static note with functional dropzone (drag-drop + click-to-browse, dedup by name, file list with remove buttons, draft re-select notice). Replaced Mode A step 5 matching-note with column picker select and previewMatches derived table (filename / match value / status). Extended DraftState with matchColumn and selectedFileNames; updated saveDraft/loadDraft accordingly. Added formatSize helper. Rewrote launch() to keep Mode B/C path byte-identical and add Mode A 4-step flow (create → upload files → match → activate) with continueAfterUnmatchedWarning. Updated Step 10 to show Mode A progress list and unmatched warning card with Go Back / Continue Anyway buttons. npm run check: 0 errors in wizard page; 30 pre-existing errors in other unrelated files confirmed present before this change.
